concerns.text: The column definitions for `data/derived/stress_curves.parquet` in `data-model.md` (e.g., `clip_id`, `model_name`, `snr_db`, `rt60_s`, `distortion_type`, `asr_hypothesis`, `wer`, `sss`, `timestamp`) do not match the JSON schema `contracts/stress_curves.schema.yaml` (which expects fields like `curve_id`, `audio_id`, `model_id`, `vector_id`, `snr_db`, `rt60_sec`, `ss_score`, `wer`, `hypothesis`, `reference_transcript`, `timestamp`). This cross‑document inconsistency means the pipeline may produce a Parquet file that fails schema validation (FR‑034). Align the data model with the contract or update the contract to reflect the intended columns.

The plan does not explicitly designate a Single Source of Truth (SSoT) file (e.g., `data-model.md`) as required by Constitution Principle IV. While the plan references the data model, it should state which artifact serves as the authoritative SSoT to satisfy the principle.
